blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are an important tool for mechanistic interpretability, but interpreting their many features remains challenging. Existing methods characterize input-side activation patterns and output-side intervention effects, yet often leave their functional connection implicit, while input-side evidence collection typically relies on costly large-corpus scans. We introduce functional interpretation , which characterizes an SAE feature as a mapping from its activating input semantics to its output effects under intervention, and present Dual-End Agentic Feature Interpretation (DAFI), an agent that actively gathers evidence and refines input-side, output-side, and functional interpretations through component-specific feedback. Its short-context token probing enables on-demand activation evidence collection without a full corpus scan. On GemmaScope, DAFI improves Input score by 13.1 percentage points over SAGE and Output score by 38.9 points over Token Change, while being substantially more token-efficient than a general-purpose coding agent. Skills distilled from successful refinements raise the held-out joint pass rate from 58.0% to 92.0% and improve both interpretation quality and efficiency when transferred to a new model–SAE setting. Across features with reliable endpoint interpretations, 70.7% exhibit non-equivalent input and output semantics. On AxBench, DAFI also improves steering-feature selection over output-score filtering. Code is available at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/DAFI .
blocks.zh: Sparse自动编码器(SAEs)是机械解释的重要工具,但解释其许多特性仍然具有挑战性. 现有方法定性为输入侧激活模式和输出侧干预效应,但往往会让其功能连接隐含,而输入侧证据收集通常依赖于昂贵的大公司扫描. 我们引入了功能解释,将SAE特征定性为从激活输入语义到干预下输出效果的映射,并提出了双端代理特性解释(DAFI),这个代理人通过特定组件的反馈积极收集证据并完善输入侧,输出侧和功能解释. 它的短文符号检测可以进行点播激活证据的收集,而无需进行全方位扫描. 在GemmaScope上,DAFI将输入分数比SAGE提高13.1个百分点,将输出分数比Token Change提高38.9个百分点,同时与通用编码代理相比,象征性效率要高得多. 成功改进后产生的技能将停产联合合格率从58.0%提高到92.0%,并在转而采用新的模式-SAE时提高口译质量和效率。 具有可靠端点解释的特征,70.7%显示非等效输入和输出语义. 在Ax Bench上,DAFI还比输出分数过滤改进了方向特性选择. 代码见https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/DAFI。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of DAFI’s three-component interpretation target.
blocks.zh: 图1:DAFI的三个组成部分解释目标概览。

blocks.en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) map dense model activations into a higher-dimensional sparse feature space, yielding tens of thousands of fine-grained features per dictionary for mechanistic analysis ( Elhage et al., 2022 ; Huben et al., 2024 ; Bricken et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Lieberum et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) . How to reliably interpret these features remains an open problem. Existing automated methods interpret those features from two endpoints: input-side methods characterize activation contexts ( Bills et al., 2023 ; Paulo et al., 2025 ; Maher et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ) ; output-side methods characterize causal effects on model outputs ( Paulo et al., 2025 ; Gur-Arieh et al., 2025 ) . Neither endpoint fully characterizes a feature. For example, a feature may activate on cat-related tokens but promote affectionate descriptors such as cute and lovely when intervened on. Labeling it as either a “cat-related feature” or a “cute-related feature” captures only one endpoint. Viewed from input to output, the feature maps cat-related activation contexts to affectionate output effects. This explanation describes the feature’s function during model inference. We refer to such an input–output explanation as a functional interpretation (Figure 1 ). Existing input-side methods also scan a fixed large corpus for activation evidence. These scans amortize across many features but are inefficient for small feature sets.
blocks.zh: Sparse 自动编码器(SAEs)将密集的模型激活映射到一个更高维度的稀疏特征空间,每个词典产生数万个细纹特征用于机械分析(Elhage等人,2022年;Huben等人,2024年;Bricken等人,2023年;Gao等人,2025年;Lieberum等人,2024年;Deng等人,2026年). 如何可靠地解释这些特征仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。 现有自动方法从两个端点来解释这些特征:输入边方法说明激活背景(Bills等人,2023年;Paulo等人,2025年;Maher等人,2026年;Han等人,2026年);产出边方法说明对模型产出的因果关系。 (Paulo等人,2025年;Gur-Arieh等人,2025年) 两个端点都没有完全描述一个特征。 例如,一个特性可能在与猫有关的符物上激活,但在介入时会促进可爱和可爱等亲切的描述. 标注为“与猫有关的特性”或“与猫有关的特性”只能捕捉到一个终点。 从输入到输出的视图中,特征映射出与猫相关的激活环境,以感动输出效果. 这一解释描述了该特征在模型推论期间的功能. 我们把这种投入-产出解释称为功能解释(图1)。 现有的输入侧方法还扫描了固定的大块体,用于激活证据. 这些扫描在许多特性上进行分期摊销,但对小型特性集来说效率低下。

blocks.en: Reliable feature interpretation involves heterogeneous evidence and requires different refinement operations across the three components ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Maher et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ) . The next operation depends on the evidence and diagnostic feedback, so the refinement trajectory cannot be fixed in advance. An agent selects the next operation accordingly.
blocks.zh: 可靠特征解释涉及各种证据,需要三个组成部分的不同改进操作(Ma等人,2025年;Maher等人,2026年;Han等人,2026年)。 接下来的操作取决于证据和诊断反馈,因此精密的轨迹无法事先固定. 代理将相应选择下一个操作 。

blocks.en: To address these problems, we make the following contributions:
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们作出以下贡献:

blocks.en: • We formulate SAE feature interpretation as a three-component target comprising input-side, output-side, and functional interpretations, with component-specific diagnostics and an overall criterion requiring all three components to pass. Using an Equivalent–Shift–Break taxonomy, we find that most features with reliable endpoint interpretations fall into the Shift or Break categories, underscoring the need for functional interpretation to determine whether and how the two endpoints are connected. • We introduce Dual-End Agentic Feature Interpretation (DAFI), an agent that actively acquires evidence and selectively refines failed components, and validate it across two LLM–SAE settings. On matched GemmaScope features, DAFI outperforms component-matched input- and output-side baselines while additionally producing functional interpretations. • We equip DAFI with tools and a self-evolving mechanism to support on-demand evidence collection and improvement across features. For targeted features, its short-context token probing collects input-side evidence on demand without requiring a full corpus scan, while achieving input-side scores comparable to those obtained from corpus-derived activation examples. DAFI self-evolves by distilling refinements into reusable skills that improve interpretation quality and efficiency on unseen features and transfer across LLM–SAE settings.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们把SAE的特征解释作为三个组成部分的目标,包括投入方、产出方和功能性解释,并附有特定组成部分的诊断和要求所有三个组成部分都通过的总体标准。 使用等效-Shift-Break分类法,我们发现,大多数具有可靠端点解释的特征都属于Shift或Break类别,强调功能解释的必要性,以确定这两个端点是否以及如何相连。 我们引入了双端代理特性解释(DAFI),这是一个积极获取证据和有选择地精炼失败组件的代理,并通过两个LLM-SAE设置验证. 在匹配的GemmaScope特性上,DAFI在额外产生功能解释的同时,超越了组件匹配输入和输出侧基线。 我们为DAFI配备了各种工具和自我演变的机制,以支持根据需要收集和改进各种特征的证据。 对于有针对性的特征,它的短文符号验证按需收集输入方证据,而不需要进行全面的方块扫描,同时实现与从实体生成的激活实例中获得的输入方分数相当的输入方分数. DAFI通过提炼可重复使用的技能来自我发展,这些技能可提高在看不见的特性上的判读质量和效率,并在整个LLM-SAE环境中进行转让。

blocks.en: We formulate SAE feature interpretation as a three-component target comprising input-side, output-side, and functional interpretations, with component-specific diagnostics and an overall criterion requiring all three components to pass. Using an Equivalent–Shift–Break taxonomy, we find that most features with reliable endpoint interpretations fall into the Shift or Break categories, underscoring the need for functional interpretation to determine whether and how the two endpoints are connected.
blocks.zh: 我们把SAE的特征解释作为三个组成部分的目标,包括投入方、产出方和功能性解释,并附有特定组成部分的诊断和要求所有三个组成部分都通过的总体标准。 使用等效-Shift-Break分类法,我们发现大多数具有可靠端点解释的特征都属于Shift或Break类,强调功能解释的必要性,以确定这两个端点是否和如何连接.

blocks.en: We introduce Dual-End Agentic Feature Interpretation (DAFI), an agent that actively acquires evidence and selectively refines failed components, and validate it across two LLM–SAE settings. On matched GemmaScope features, DAFI outperforms component-matched input- and output-side baselines while additionally producing functional interpretations.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了双端代理特性解释(DAFI),这是一个积极获取证据和有选择地精炼失败组件的代理,并通过两个LLM-SAE设置验证. 在匹配的GemmaScope特性上,DAFI超越了组件匹配输入和输出侧基线,同时额外产生功能解释.

blocks.en: We equip DAFI with tools and a self-evolving mechanism to support on-demand evidence collection and improvement across features. For targeted features, its short-context token probing collects input-side evidence on demand without requiring a full corpus scan, while achieving input-side scores comparable to those obtained from corpus-derived activation examples. DAFI self-evolves by distilling refinements into reusable skills that improve interpretation quality and efficiency on unseen features and transfer across LLM–SAE settings.
blocks.zh: 我们为DAFI配备了各种工具和自我演变的机制,以支持根据需要收集和改进各种特征的证据。 对于有针对性的特征,它的短文符号验证按需收集输入方证据,而不需要进行全面的方块扫描,同时实现与从实体生成的激活实例中获得的输入方分数相当的输入方分数. DAFI通过提炼可重复使用的技能来自我发展,这些技能可提高在看不见的特性上的判读质量和效率,并在整个LLM-SAE环境中进行转让。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) learn a sparse, higher-dimensional representation of dense LLM activations: an encoder maps each activation to sparse feature coefficients, and a decoder reconstructs the activation from those features, providing finer-grained units than polysemantic neurons ( Elhage et al., 2022 ; Huben et al., 2024 ; Bricken et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Rajamanoharan et al., 2024 ) . Interpreting these features helps us understand model mechanisms ( Bricken et al., 2023 ; Huben et al., 2024 ; Jing et al., 2025 ; Marks et al., 2025 ) . We aim to provide more complete interpretations of SAE features and more effective methods for producing them.
blocks.zh: Sparse自动编码器(SAEs)学习了密度LLM激活的稀疏、更高维度的表示:一个编码器将每次激活都映射到稀疏的特征系数,一个解码器从这些特征重建激活,提供比多语种神经元更精细的单位(Elhage等人,2022年;Huben等人,2024年;Bricken等人,2023年;Gao等人,2025年;Rajamanoharan等人,2024年)。 解释这些特征有助于我们理解模型机制(Bricken等人,2023年;Huben等人,2024年;Jing等人,2025年;Marks等人,2025年)。 我们的目标是对SAE特征提供更完整的解释,并采用更有效的方法制作这些特征。

blocks.en: Existing automated methods follow two main approaches: input-side and output-side interpretation. Input-side methods interpret features based on activating examples, with recent agentic variants iteratively refining their interpretations ( Bills et al., 2023 ; Huben et al., 2024 ; Paulo et al., 2025 ; Maher et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ) . Collecting this evidence relies on a full corpus scan, which is costly when interpreting a few features of interest ( Gur-Arieh et al., 2025 ) . Output-side methods use vocabulary projections or feature interventions to characterize changes in model outputs, but lack fine-grained diagnostics for iteratively refining output-side hypotheses ( Paulo et al., 2025 ; Gur-Arieh et al., 2025 ) . Prior work either interprets a feature from a single endpoint or simply combines evidence from both endpoints into a single feature interpretation ( Gur-Arieh et al., 2025 ) . We instead introduce a functional interpretation that characterizes a feature as a mapping from its input-side activation pattern to its causal output effects. DAFI evaluates all three interpretations separately and uses component-specific feedback to guide refinement, while short-context token probing enables on-demand input-side evidence collection.
blocks.zh: 现有的自动化方法主要遵循两种方法:投入方和产出方解释. 输入边方法根据激活实例解释特征,最近的代理变体反复完善其解释(Bills等人,2023年;Huben等人,2024年;Paulo等人,2025年;Maher等人,2026年;Han等人,2026年). 收集这些证据依赖于全方位扫描,在解释一些值得关注的特征时费用高昂(Gur-Arieh等人,2025年)。 产出侧方法使用词汇预测或特征干预来描述模型产出的变化,但缺乏精细的诊断来反复完善产出侧假设(Paulo等人,2025年;Gur-Arieh等人,2025年)。 先前的工作要么从单一端点解释一个特征,要么简单地将两个端点的证据合并为单一特征解释(Gur-Arieh等人,2025年)。 相反,我们采用了一种功能解释,将一个特征定性为从输入方激活模式到其因果输出效应的绘图。 DAFI单独评价所有三种解释,并使用特定组成部分的反馈来指导完善,而短文本符号验证则能够按需收集输入方证据.

blocks.en: Building on early reasoning-and-action and self-reflection agents ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) , recent self-evolving systems improve across tasks by accumulating and reusing experience ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 在早期推理与动作和自我反省剂的基础上(姚等人,2023年;申恩等人,2023年),近期的自我演化系统通过积累和再利用经验改进了跨任务(王等人,2024年;赵等人,2024年;胡等人,2025年;殷等人,2025年;郑等人,2025年;张等人,2026年a).

blocks.en: Such experience can be retained at different levels of abstraction, from concrete cases to transferable strategies ( Suzgun et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . DAFI retains successful revisions as case skills and distills recurring patterns into general skills for interpreting subsequent features.
blocks.zh: 这种经验可以保留在不同层次的抽象,从具体案例到可转移策略(Suzgun等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年b). DAFI保留了成功的修改,作为案例技能,并将反复出现的模式提炼成解释后续特征的一般技能.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: DAFI evaluates input-side, output-side, and functional interpretations, uses their diagnostics to guide an agent loop, and distills successful revisions into reusable skills (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: DAFI评价输入侧面,输出侧面,以及功能解释,用他们的诊断来引导一个代理循环,并提炼成功的修改为可重复使用的技能(图2 ).

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation: Endpoint and Relational Interpretations
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出:终点和关系解释

blocks.en: Activation-based methods explain what inputs activate a feature, with agentic variants refining these descriptions through activation feedback ( Bills et al., 2023 ; Paulo et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2026 ) . Output-centric methods characterize downstream effects, and combining input and output descriptions improves faithfulness ( Gur-Arieh et al., 2025 ) . We extend this view by treating the functional connection between the endpoints as a distinct, testable interpretation target: how a feature links its activating conditions to the output behavior it promotes.
blocks.zh: 基于激活的方法解释了哪些投入激活了一种特征,其代理变量通过激活反馈来完善这些描述(Bills等人,2023年;Paulo等人,2025年;Han等人,2026年)。 以产出为中心的方法是下游效应的特点,将投入和产出描述结合起来,提高了可靠性(Gur-Arieh等人,2025年)。 我们扩展这一观点,将端点之间的功能连接视为一个独特的,可测试的解释目标:一个特征如何将它的激活条件与它所促进的输出行为联系起来.

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates a feature activated by cat and kitten that promotes cute and lovely when amplified. The functional interpretation is that the feature preferentially responds to cat-related semantics, and amplifying this activation biases the model toward affectionate expression.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了猫和小猫在放大时促进可爱和可爱的特点。 功能解释是,该特征优于与猫有关的语义反应,并放大了这种激活偏差,模式倾向于亲切的表达.

blocks.en: Given a language model, an SAE, and a target feature i i , we seek a hypothesis triplet H t ​ ( i ) = ( h t in , h t out , h t c ) , H_{t}(i)=\left(h_{t}^{\mathrm{in}},h_{t}^{\mathrm{out}},h_{t}^{c}\right), where t t is the refinement round. The input hypothesis h t in h_{t}^{\mathrm{in}} describes the semantic concepts that preferentially activate the feature. The output hypothesis h t out h_{t}^{\mathrm{out}} describes the semantic bias induced in the model’s output by intervening on the feature. The functional hypothesis h t c h_{t}^{c} explains the feature’s role in linking its activating semantics to this intervention-induced output bias. These components are evaluated separately to guide targeted refinement.

blocks.en: 3.2 Metric Design
blocks.zh: 3.2 计量设计

blocks.en: We evaluate the hypothesis triplet using three scores. The Input score measures whether the input hypothesis captures the feature’s activation preferences and semantic boundaries. The Output score measures whether the output hypothesis captures the semantic bias induced by feature intervention. The Functional score assesses whether the activating input semantics and intervention-induced output semantics have a coherent semantic relation, and whether the functional hypothesis accurately describes this relation using evidence from both endpoints.
blocks.zh: 我们用三个分数来评价假说三重奏 输入分数衡量输入假说是否捕捉到特性的激活偏好和语义边界. 输出分数衡量输出假说是否捕捉到特征干预引发的语义偏差. 功能分数评估激活的输入语义和干预引发的输出语义是否具有连贯的语义关系,功能假说是否利用两个端点的证据准确描述这种关系.

blocks.en: 3.3 Agent Design
blocks.zh: 3.3 代理设计

blocks.en: Figure 2 b presents DAFI’s self-improving agent loop, which combines metric-guided diagnosis, flexible tool use, and hypothesis refinement. The agent repeatedly evaluates and updates the hypothesis triplet, while successful revisions are distilled into reusable skills that guide subsequent interpretations.
blocks.zh: 图2b介绍了DAFI的自我改进剂循环,该循环结合了计量制导的诊断,灵活的工具使用和假说完善. 该剂反复评价和更新假说三重体,而成功的修订则被提炼成可重复使用的技能,指导后续解释.

blocks.en: DAFI investigates a feature’s role during generation by examining its output effects in the contexts that activate it. Input-side evidence guides the choice of intervention contexts and token positions, while the resulting output changes help assess whether and how the activating semantics relate to the promoted semantics. The functional hypothesis thus provides an explicit relation to investigate through coordinated probing and intervention.
blocks.zh: DAFI通过在激活时检查其输出效果来调查一个特性在生成过程中的作用. 输入方证据指导了干预背景和象征性位置的选择,而由此产生的产出变化有助于评估激活语义是否和如何与促进语义相关。 因此,功能假设为通过协调的探测和干预进行调查提供了明确的关系。

blocks.en: Starting from an initial hypothesis triplet, the agent reasons over metric feedback and the underlying evidence to decide which hypotheses to revise and what to test next. It can refine a description using existing observations or adjust probing and intervention conditions to obtain further evidence. When the input–output relation remains unclear, these choices allow the agent to investigate the connection and revise the functional hypothesis based on newly observed effects. The agent re-evaluates the updated triplet and repeats this process until all criteria pass or refinement stops, returning the best-supported complete triplet.
blocks.zh: 从初始假说三进制开始,代理商会比量反馈和基础证据更有理由决定哪些假说需要修改,接下来测试什么. 它可以利用现有的观察来完善描述,或调整探测和干预条件以获取进一步的证据. 当输入-输出关系仍然不明确时,这些选择允许代理人根据新观察到的效果调查连接并修改功能假说. 代理重新评估更新的三重奏,并重复这一过程,直到所有标准通过或完善停止,还原得到最好支持的完整三重奏.

blocks.en: The agent carries out refinements using configurable evidence-collection tools.
blocks.zh: 该代理人使用可配置的取证工具进行改进。

blocks.en: On the input side, it can retrieve corpus-derived activating examples from Neuronpedia 4 4 4 https://www.neuronpedia.org/ or use short-context token probing . This tool inserts candidate vocabulary tokens into configurable templates, such as The {token} and <bos>{token} , allowing full-vocabulary probing with short inputs for a target feature. The agent can adjust templates and surrounding context to identify activating conditions and refine the input hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 在输入方面,它可以从Neuronpedia 4 4 4 https://www.neuronpedia.org/中检索出从实体衍生的激活实例。 或使用短文符号验证 。 此工具将候选词汇符插入可配置的模板, 如 The {token} 和 < bos>{token} , 允许对目标特性进行全程输入验证 。 代理可以调整模板和周围上下文,以识别激活条件并完善输入假说.

blocks.en: On the output side, the agent can intervene in activating contexts, targeting the maximally activating token by default. It can adjust intervention strength, token position, and prompt context, then inspect positive and negative output-token logit changes. These observations identify the output semantics promoted or suppressed under the selected conditions, guiding subsequent interventions and revisions to the output and functional hypotheses.
blocks.zh: 在输出方面,代理可以在激活上下文中进行干预,默认时针对最大激活符. 它可以调整干预强度,符号位置,以及迅速的上下文,然后检查正负输出键对数变化. 这些意见确定了在选定条件下推动或压制的产出语义,指导后续的干预和对产出和功能假设的修订.

blocks.en: Successful revisions are stored as case skills; recurring diagnostic and repair patterns are distilled into general skills. These skills guide later hypotheses, tool choices, probing contexts, intervention settings, and rerun scope, allowing effective evidence-acquisition and refinement strategies to be reused across features. The reusable-skills branch in Figure 2 feeds this experience into subsequent runs and supports transfer across language model and SAE settings.
blocks.zh: 成功的修订作为个案技能储存;经常性诊断和维修模式被提炼成一般技能。 这些技能指导了后来的假设、工具选择、探险背景、干预设置和重置范围,从而能够跨特征重新使用有效的证据获取和完善战略。 图2中的可重复使用技能分支将这一经验反馈到后续运行中,并支持跨语言模型和SAE设置的传输.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Our experiments evaluate whether DAFI can interpret what activates an SAE feature, how it affects model output, and the functional connection between these endpoints at a practical computational cost. We compare interpretation quality and cost with existing methods, examine individual design choices, and test whether accumulated experience transfers to unseen features and a new LLM–SAE setting. For features with well-supported endpoint interpretations, we classify their semantic relations as Equivalent, Shift, or Break.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验评价了DAFI是否能够解释什么激活SAE特性,它如何影响模型输出,以及这些端点之间的功能连接,以实际的计算成本. 我们比较解释质量和成本与现有方法,审查个别的设计选择,并测试积累的经验是否转移到了看不见的特性和新的LLM-SAE设置。 对于有良好支持的端点解释的特征,我们将其语义关系归类为等价,Shift,或Break.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiment Setting
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: DAFI generates initial input-side, output-side, and functional hypotheses for each target feature and refines them for up to 10 rounds. We evaluate the three components using the Input, Output, and Functional scores, respectively, as defined in Section 3.2 . Input score is the harmonic mean of activation coverage and boundary rejection. The input-side component passes only if both underlying components are at least 0.8; the output-side and functional components pass if Output score is at least 0.5 and Functional score is at least 4, respectively. Joint success requires the selected complete triplet to satisfy all criteria.
blocks.zh: DAFI为每个目标特性生成初始输入侧,输出侧,功能假说,并对其进行精炼,最多可达10发. 我们分别使用第3.2节界定的输入、产出和功能分数来评价这三个组成部分。 输入分数是激活覆盖和边界拒绝的谐波平均值. 只有在两个基本组成部分至少0.8个时,输入侧部分才能通过;如果输出分数至少0.5个,功能分数至少4个,则输出侧部分和功能部分才能通过。 联合成功需要选定的完整的三胞胎满足所有标准。

blocks.en: For the main experiments, we use GemmaScope ( Lieberum et al., 2024 ) , a suite of pretrained sparse autoencoders for Gemma 2, specifically the gemmascope-res-16k residual-stream SAEs for Gemma-2-2B ( Gemma Team et al., 2024 ) . We sample equal numbers of features from layers 0, 6, 12, 18, and 24. For the cross-setting transfer experiment, we use Qwen-Scope ( Deng et al., 2026 ) W32K residual-stream SAEs using Top- k k activation with k = 50 k=50 for Qwen3-1.7B-Base ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , sampling 20 features from each of layers 0, 7, 14, 21, and 27.
blocks.zh: 对于主要实验,我们使用GemmaScope(Lieberum等人,2024年),即Gemma 2的一套预先训练的稀疏自动编码器,特别是Gemmascope-res-16k残流SAEs用于Gemma-2-2B(Gemma Team等人,2024年). 我们从0、6、12、18和24层取样了相同数量的特征。 对于交叉设置转移实验,我们使用Quen-Scope(Deng等人,2026年) W32K残流SAE使用Top-kk激活,k=50k=50对Quen3-1.7B-Base(杨等人,2025年),从每层0,7,14,21和27中取样20个特征.

blocks.en: We use DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) as the backbone model for hypothesis generation, refinement, and primary automated evaluation, with temperature set to 0. To avoid potential same-model evaluation bias ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , we independently re-evaluate all eligible output-side and functional hypotheses from the final traces of the 250-feature GemmaScope experiment using GPT-5.6-Sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . GPT-5.6-Sol receives the same evidence and scoring rules as DeepSeek-V4-Pro, but not DeepSeek-V4-Pro’s original scores or rationales. To assess agreement with human judgments, two researchers with experience in SAE interpretability independently rate functional interpretation quality on a stratified 40-feature sample while blinded to the system scores and to each other’s labels. Appendices H and G report the respective protocols and results.
blocks.zh: 我们使用DeepSeek-V4-Pro(DeepSeek-AI,2026年)作为假设生成,完善和初级自动化评价的骨干模型,温度设定为0. 为了避免潜在的同型评价偏差(Panicksery等人,2024年;徐等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年),我们独立地重新评价了从250天的GemmaScope实验(OpenAI,2026年)的最终痕迹中得出的所有合格的产出侧面和功能假说. GPT-5.6-Sol得到与DeepSeek-V4-Pro相同的证据和评分规则,但不是DeepSeek-V4-Pro的原始分数或理由. 为了评估与人类判断的一致性,在SAE可解释性方面具有经验的两名研究人员在分级的40个特性样本上独立评定功能解释质量,同时对系统得分和彼此的标签视而不见。 附录H和G报告各自的协议和结果。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results and Evaluation Reliability
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果和评价可靠性

blocks.en: We compare DAFI’s interpretation quality and efficiency with component-matched and end-to-end baselines. The evaluation scores the three components of each interpretation triplet separately: Input score summarizes activation coverage and boundary rejection using their harmonic mean, Output score evaluates the output-side interpretation based on observed intervention-induced token changes, and Functional score evaluates the functional relation between the two endpoints. The appendix reports the two Input score components separately.
blocks.zh: 我们比较DAFI的判读质量和效率与组件匹配和端对端基线. 评价对每种解释的三个部分分别进行评分: 输入分数用其谐音平均值总结激活覆盖和边界拒绝,输出分数根据观察到的干预引发的符号变化评价输出方解释,功能分数评价两个端点之间的功能关系. 附录分别报告两个输入分数部分。

blocks.en: Because existing SAE interpretation methods do not directly produce the full triplet of input-side, output-side, and functional interpretations, we use both component-matched and end-to-end baselines. Each DAFI run produces the complete triplet. For component-matched comparisons, we compare its input-side component with SAGE ( Han et al., 2026 ) and its output-side component with Token Change ( Gur-Arieh et al., 2025 ) on 100 features. For the end-to-end comparison, we use Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2026 ) as a baseline, prompting it to generate hypotheses for all three components following basic diagnostic instructions specified in CLAUDE.md . We evaluate both a budget-restricted configuration, whose round-start budget is set by DAFI’s per-feature usage, and unrestricted execution. Because of Claude Code’s high execution cost, both configurations use 25 features and are marked with an asterisk in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 由于现有的SAE解释方法并不直接产生投入侧面,输出侧面,功能侧面的三重解释,因此我们同时使用组件匹配和端对端基线. 每个DAFI运行 产生完整的三胞胎。 对于组件匹配的比较,我们将其输入侧组件与SAGE(Han等人,2026年)及其输出侧组件与Token Change(Gur-Arieh等人,2025年)在100个特性上进行比较。 为了进行端到端的比较,我们使用克劳德码(Anthropic, 2026)作为基线,促使它根据CLAUDE.md规定的基本诊断指示生成所有三个组件的假说. 我们既评价预算限制的配置,又评价不受限制的执行。 由于Claude Code的执行成本高昂,两款配置都使用25个特性,并在表1中标注星号.

blocks.en: Against the two component-matched baselines on 100 features, DAFI achieves a 13.1-point higher Input score than SAGE (91.4% versus 78.3%). DAFI also uses fewer tokens per feature (0.758M versus 0.796M), while additionally producing output-side and functional interpretations. Compared with Token Change, DAFI’s iterative refinement achieves a higher Output score (66.7% versus 27.8%), with higher and more consistent scores across layers. Appendix J reports the Input score components and detailed results for the Claude Code configurations. Table 21 in Appendix K reports the layer-wise output comparison. Layer-wise refinement results and analysis are reported in Appendix D .

blocks.en: Because the Output and Functional scores contain LLM-judged components, we first assess their cross-model consistency; for the Functional score, we additionally compare the scores with human judgments. GPT-5.6-Sol agrees with DeepSeek-V4-Pro on 87.1% of Output score and 80.4% of Functional score pass decisions; Appendix H reports the full results. In a separate human evaluation, two researchers with experience in SAE-based interpretability independently review a sample of 40 features. Functional score correlates with their ratings of functional interpretation quality (Spearman ρ = 0.809 \rho=0.809 and 0.777 0.777 ), with binary agreement of 95.0% and 92.5%, respectively. These results support agreement between Functional score and human judgments of functional interpretation quality; Appendix G reports the full statistics.
blocks.zh: 由于输出和功能分数包含LLM判断的组件,我们首先评估它们的跨模型一致性;对于功能分数,我们额外比较分数与人类判断. GPT-5.6-Sol同意DeepSeek-V4-Pro关于产出分数87.1%和功能分数80.4%的通过决定;附录H报告全部结果. 在单独的人类评价中,两位在基于SAE的可解释性方面具有经验的研究人员独立审查40个特征的样本. 功能分数与其对功能解释质量的评级相关(Spearman $ = 0.809\rho = 0.809和 0.777 0.777),二进制协议分别为95.0%和92.5%. 这些结果支持功能分数与人类对功能解释质量的判断之间的一致;附录G报告了全部统计数据。

blocks.zh: 4.3 设计分析

blocks.en: We next evaluate three design elements: short-context probing as an alternative evidence source, skill accumulation through sequential interpretation, and skill transfer across LLM–SAE settings.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来评估三个设计要素:作为替代证据来源的短文证明、通过顺序解释积累技能以及跨越LLM-SAE环境的技能转让。

blocks.en: Corpus scanning can amortize inference across many features, but it is costly for small feature sets and limited by the coverage of a fixed dataset. We assess short-context token probing as an alternative source of initial evidence on 100 GemmaScope features, starting from a single <bos>{token} template. After refinement, probing achieves a larger Input score gain than Neuronpedia initialization (15.8 versus 9.3 percentage points), although its final Input score remains lower (88.5% versus 91.4%; Table 2 ). Appendix F.1 reports activation coverage and boundary rejection separately. For a single feature, initialization and average follow-up scans process 0.59M input token positions, 87.4% fewer than the 4.72M-position corpus pass. Appendix F.2 examines processing volume across feature-set sizes. Two examples further show that short-context probing can recover activating tokens absent from available corpus-derived examples and reveal context-dependent activations through adaptive context selection (Appendix F.3 ).
blocks.zh: Corpus扫描可以将许多特性的推论分期摊还,但小型特性集的成本很高,并受到固定数据集覆盖的限制. 我们从单一的<bos>{token}模板开始, 将短文本符号验证作为100 GemmaScope 特性的初步证据的替代来源。 经过完善,探险取得了比Neuronpedia初始化(15.8对9.3个百分点)更大的输入得分收益,尽管其最终输入得分仍然较低(88.5%对91.4%;表2). 附录F.1分别报告激活覆盖范围和拒绝边界。 对于一个单一的特性,初始化和平均后续扫描过程0.59M输入符位置,比4.72M位置的通过率低87.4%. 附录F.2审查了各特征设定大小的处理量。 有两个例子进一步表明,短文验证可以恢复现有实体衍生实例中缺失的激活符,并通过适应性上下文选择揭示依赖上下文的激活符(附录F.3)。

blocks.en: We test whether experience from earlier features improves interpretation quality on unseen features and reduces refinement effort. DAFI accumulates skills through sequential interpretation of 120 features, with performance on a fixed held-out suite assessed after every 20 features. Skill accumulation raises the joint pass rate by 34.0 percentage points while reducing refinement rounds (Figure 3 ). Most of the pass-rate gain appears within the first 20 features, with further accumulation sustaining higher quality at fewer refinement rounds. This suggests that useful strategies emerge early and continue to benefit subsequent interpretations.
blocks.zh: 我们检验早先的特征的经验是否提高了对看不见特征的诠释质量,并减少了完善努力。 DAFI通过对120个特性的顺序解释来积累技能,每20个特性后对固定的搁置套件的性能进行评估. 技能积累将联赛通过率提高了34.0个百分点,同时减少了精密回合(图3 )。 多数的通过率增益出现在前20个特征中,进一步的积累在更少的精细回合中保持更高的质量. 这表明,有用的战略很早就出现,而且继续有利于随后的解释。

blocks.en: 4.4 What Dual-End Interpretation Reveals about SAE Features
blocks.zh: 4.4 何种双端解释 关于SAE特征的启示

blocks.en: We examine how the semantics that activate an SAE feature relate to the output semantics promoted by intervention. Our analysis covers 215 features from the 250-feature pool whose input and output interpretations both pass, allowing us to compare well-supported descriptions of the two endpoints.
blocks.zh: 我们研究激活SAE特性的语义与干预所推动的输出语义的关系. 我们的分析涵盖250个地貌集合的215个特征,其投入和产出解释都通过,使我们能够比较两个端点得到良好支持的描述。

blocks.en: Most endpoint pairs are not equivalent. Shift and Break account for 70.7% of the analyzed features (Figure 4.4 ). Input interpretations alone therefore often miss a feature’s output semantics. Dual-end interpretation captures both its activating concept and its output bias. Semantic shifts reveal functional mappings. Shift is the largest group at 63.7% . These features respond to one concept while promoting a related but distinct output concept. Functional interpretation explains how this mapping biases generation.

The resulting functional interpretation clarifies each feature’s role during model inference by explaining how it shapes generation in the contexts that activate it.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: DAFI interprets SAE features through input-side, output-side, and functional hypotheses. Equivalent, Shift, and Break relations show that the endpoints often differ, motivating explicit interpretation of their connection. Guided by diagnostic feedback, DAFI coordinates probing and interventions and reuses skills to refine these hypotheses. It improves Input and Output scores over SAGE and Token Change, respectively, while producing functional interpretations. Short-context probing reduces inference volume and uncovers evidence absent from available corpus examples. Reusable skills improve later interpretations and transfer across LLM–SAE settings. Future work will investigate lower-cost interpretation and downstream model editing.
blocks.zh: DAFI通过输入侧,输出侧,功能假说来解释SAE特性. 等价关系,Shift,和Break关系显示,端点往往不同,促使明确解释它们之间的联系. 在诊断反馈的指导下,DAFI协调检测和干预及再利用技能,以完善这些假设. 它分别比SAGE和Token Change改进输入和输出分数,同时产生功能解释. 短文调查减少了推断量,并发现了现有物证中缺少的证据。 可重复使用的技能改进了以后的解释和跨越LLM-SAE环境的转移。 今后的工作将调查费用较低的口译和下游模型编辑。

blocks.en: The pipeline is decomposed into nine steps. Steps 1 to 4 produce and evaluate the input hypothesis. Steps 5 to 7 run intervention, generate the output hypothesis, and score it. Steps 8 and 9 build and judge the functional hypothesis. The agent supports selective rerun, so a patch that changes output guidance can retain previously collected input evidence rather than rerunning the whole pipeline. This reduces token usage and variability from regenerating unaffected components. Each candidate contains a complete interpretation triplet and its associated scores. Best-round selection retains one candidate as a whole, including the endpoint hypotheses linked by its functional interpretation.
blocks.zh: 管道分解为九步. 步骤1至步骤4产生和评价输入假设。 步骤5至7运行干预,生成输出假说,并得分. 步骤8和步骤9构建和判断功能假设. 代理支持选择性重运行,因此修改输出引导的补丁可以保留之前收集的输入证据,而不是重运行整个管道. 这减少了象征性的使用,减少了重新生成未受影响的部件所产生的变化。 每个候选人都包含一个完整的解释三进制及其相关分数. 最佳轮选保留了一个整体候选人,包括与其功能解释相联系的终点假设.

blocks.en: Appendix C Explanation and Judge Templates

blocks.en: Each generation call is constrained to one component of the explanation object. The input prompt receives activating tokens and contexts and asks for a concise hypothesis with explicit exclusions. The output prompt receives positive and negative intervention deltas and asks for the narrowest description that covers promoted evidence without also covering suppressed evidence. The functional-interpretation prompt receives both hypotheses and their supporting evidence, but it is not allowed to introduce an unobserved intermediate mechanism.
blocks.zh: 每代调用都受限制于解释对象的一个组件. 输入提示收到激活符号和上下文,要求有一个有明确排除的简明假设。 产出提示得到正面和负面的干预三角洲,并要求最狭义的描述,涵盖所推广的证据而不涵盖被压制的证据。 功能解释即时收到假说及其佐证证据,但不允许引入无法观察的中间机制.

blocks.en: D.1 Layer Depth Separates Input-Side Reliability from Functional Interpretation Quality
blocks.zh: D.1 层深度将输入系统可靠性与功能解释质量分离

blocks.en: Layer depth changes which component of a feature explanation is easiest to recover. As shown in Table 9 , Layer 0 achieves the highest refined activation coverage and boundary rejection, both 0.960, indicating that its input-side explanations align most reliably with feature activations under our evaluation. However, accurate input-side explanations do not necessarily imply a clearer relationship between feature activations and intervention-induced output effects. The final Functional score is 3.94 at both Layer 0 and Layer 18, compared with 4.28 at Layer 24.
blocks.zh: 层深度改变特性解释中最容易恢复的组件 。 如表9所示,第0层实现了最高精度的激活范围和边界拒绝,两者均为0.960,表明其输入方解释最可靠地符合我们评价下的特征激活。 然而,准确的输入方解释并不一定意味着特性激活和干预引起的产出效应之间的关系更加明确。 最后的功能分数在0层和18层都是3.94,而24层则是4.28.

blocks.en: Before refinement, Layer 24 also has a higher Output score than Layer 0, 0.468 versus 0.230. After refinement, their scores become similar, at 0.697 and 0.682, suggesting that targeted refinement can reduce layer-wise disparities in output-side interpretation quality. Layer 18 shows the largest Functional score improvement, from 2.62 to 3.94, while Layer 24 achieves both the highest final Functional score and the highest joint pass rate. These results distinguish input-side reliability from the clarity of the input–output relationship: strong activation-side recoverability does not by itself imply the clearest functional relationship to downstream effects. This is a layer-level tendency in explanation recoverability, not evidence that every deep feature is a better intervention target.
blocks.zh: 在完善前,第24层的输出分数也高于第0层,0.468比0.230. 经过细化后,它们的分数变得相似,分别为0.697和0.682,这表明有针对性的细化可以减少产出侧解释质量的层次差异. 第18层表现出最大的功能分数改进,从2.62到3.94,而第24层既实现了最高最终功能分数,也实现了最高联合通过率. 这些结果将投入-侧可靠性与投入-产出关系的明确性区分开来:强大的激活-侧可回收性本身并不意味着与下游效应最明确的功能关系。 这是解释可回收性的一个层层趋势,而不是证明每个深层特征都是更好的干预目标.

blocks.en: Qualitative inspection suggests that Layer 0 features often capture subword, casing, punctuation, or local morphology, while Layer 6 features often capture lexical associations. Layer 12 behaves as a transition layer in which causal narratives can be coherent but output token effects remain indirect. Layer 18 contains many deep semantic features whose explanations improve substantially after several agent rounds. Layer 24 is closest to the output side and reaches the highest joint pass rate.
blocks.zh: 定性检查表明,第0层特征往往捕捉到子词,外壳,凸起,或局部形态,而第6层特征往往捕捉到词典关联. 第12层表现为过渡层,其中因果叙述可以是连贯的,但输出符号效应仍然是间接的. 第18层包含许多深层语义特征,其解释在经过几轮剂弹后得到了很大改进. 第24层最接近输出侧面,并达到最高的关节通过率.

blocks.en: F.3 Complementary Evidence from Short-Context Probing
blocks.zh: F.3 短期证据的补充

blocks.en: Short-context probing and corpus-based initialization provide different forms of activation evidence. Corpus-based evidence is limited to the contexts represented in the available activation examples, whereas short-context probing directly tests candidate tokens across controlled templates. The following cases illustrate adaptive context discovery and evidence complementarity.
blocks.zh: 短篇证明和基于实体的初始化提供了不同形式的激活证据。 基于公司的证据仅限于现有激活实例中所反映的背景,而短文则直接通过受控模板测试候选标志。 以下案例说明了适应性背景发现和证据互补性。

blocks.en: This feature illustrates how controlled vocabulary coverage can expose activation evidence missing from available corpus-derived examples. The 45 Neuronpedia activation examples were dominated by the English token the , and none contained any of the 22 tokens activated by the initial full-vocabulary <bos>{token} scan. Representative activations include InThe (40.25), inthe (29.00), Nei (21.75), Nella (17.75), and Nel (15.25). Together with related Italian, French, Arabic, Thai, and Hebrew forms, these tokens revealed a multilingual locative pattern not represented in the available Neuronpedia examples. The most specific hypothesis—Italian prepositional articles such as nel , nella , nei , and nelle —achieved activation coverage of 1.0 and boundary rejection of 1.0. These tokens may occur in the underlying corpus, but they are absent from the evidence available to the interpreter.
blocks.zh: 这一特征说明受控制词汇的涵盖范围如何暴露出从现有物证中缺失的激活证据。 45个Neuronpedia激活例以英国的标志为主, 没有任何一个包含22个标志, 由初始的全vocabulary <bos>{token}扫描激活。 代表激活包括InThe(40.25),inthe(29.00),Nei(21.75),Nella(17.75)和Nel(15.25). 连同相关的意大利语、法语、阿拉伯语、泰语和希伯来语形式,这些符号揭示了一个没有在Neuronpedia实例中体现的多语种拼写模式。 最具体的假设——意大利语的预置文章如nel,nella,nei,和nelle——实现了1.0的激活覆盖和1.0的边界排斥. 这些标志可能出现在基本文书中,但从解释者掌握的证据中找不到这些标志。

blocks.en: This feature provides a direct example of adaptive context discovery within the 100-feature experiment. The initial full-vocabulary scan with <bos>{token} evaluated 255,994 candidate tokens but found no activation. After three consecutive Gate 1 failures, the agent tested several context prefixes, including After , Although , Despite , and In spite . A 50,000-token random scan with <bos>Despite {token} first found four activating tokens; expanding this template to the full vocabulary found 39 activating tokens and a peak activation of 9.75.
blocks.zh: 这一特征为在百度地貌实验范围内的适应环境发现提供了直接的例子. 最初使用<bos>{token}的全程扫描评价了255,994个候选标志,但没有发现激活. 在连续三次门1失败后,代理测试了多个上下文前缀,包括After,尽管,尽管,和Inspreet. 使用<bos>Deite {token}进行5万个托肯随机扫描,首先发现了四个激活符;将本模板扩展为完整的词汇,发现39个激活符,峰值激活9.75.

blocks.en: Table 13: Context discovery for Layer 18, Feature 3450. Both full scans cover the same vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 表13: 第18层的上下文发现,特征3450. 两次全扫描都覆盖了相同的词汇.

blocks.en: Representative full-scan activations include <bos>Despite soundness (9.75), <bos>Despite flawless (9.06), <bos>Despite manageable (9.00), and <bos>Despite reassurance (6.75). Because the initial scan over the same vocabulary had a maximum activation of zero, these observations isolate the effect of adding the Despite context. The trajectory selected this full-vocabulary scan as its input observation, and the final input-side hypothesis achieved activation coverage of 1.0 and boundary rejection of 1.0. This case demonstrates that the agent can adapt its probing context after an initially uninformative scan. It directly supports context-dependent activation discovery; the semantic interpretation of the discovered pattern remains a hypothesis evaluated by the subsequent pipeline.

blocks.en: This case comes from an earlier six-template diagnostic run and is not part of the 100-feature volume accounting above. The available Neuronpedia activation examples for this feature do not include the token endforeach . This absence does not establish that the token never occurs in the underlying corpus; it only shows that the token is not represented in the available activation examples. By contrast, the initial six-template short-context scan identifies endforeach as the strongest aggregate token for this feature. It appears among the top two tokens for all six templates, ranking first for five templates and second for the remaining template. Its activation ranges from 23.375 to 32.500, with a mean of 27.458 and a maximum of 32.500. Short-context probing thus recovers repeatable activation evidence absent from the available corpus examples.

blocks.en: We evaluate functional-interpretation plausibility on a stratified 40-feature subset spanning layers, final metric states, and low, middle, and high Functional scores. Each annotator rates input fit, output fit, and functional-interpretation plausibility on a five-point scale, and assigns one relation label among Equivalent, Shift and Break. We define a human plausibility pass as a plausibility rating of at least 4. For ordinal ratings, we report Spearman correlation, agreement within one point, and quadratic-weighted Cohen’s κ \kappa . For relation labels and binary pass decisions, we report unweighted Cohen’s κ \kappa .

blocks.en: For each annotator, we compute Spearman correlation across the same 40 features, assigning average ranks to tied scores. The system score for each feature is the Functional score associated with the selected complete interpretation triplet in its final trace. The input-side, output-side, and functional interpretations are retained together, and the human annotators assess this same selected triplet. We compare this shared system-score vector separately with each annotator’s plausibility ratings, without averaging or pooling the human ratings. blocks.en: Prior work on output-side feature descriptions argues that a faithful feature description should be evaluated through both the inputs that activate the feature and the outputs that change when the feature is stimulated. That framing directly motivates our Output score. Our difference is that we do not stop at an output-side description. We require the output evidence to support a functional interpretation from input context X X to output pattern Y Y , and we use the failure pattern across the three scores to decide what the agent should repair.
blocks.zh: 先前关于输出侧特征描述的工作认为,忠实特征描述应当通过激活特征的投入和激发特征时变化的输出来评价. 这种框架直接激发了我们的产出得分。 我们的区别在于,我们并不停留在产出方面。 我们要求输出证据支持从输入上下文X到输出图案Y Y的功能解释,我们使用三个分数的失败图案来决定代理应该修复什么.

It also separates two failure modes: a low coverage score means that h t out h_{t}^{\mathrm{out}} misses the promoted output evidence, while a high penalty means that the hypothesis covers tokens that the intervention actually suppresses.

We distinguish three output-side signals. VocabProj projects the SAE decoder direction through the unembedding matrix and is cheap, but it is a geometric proxy. Token Change-style evidence measures the tokens whose probabilities change after feature amplification, and is therefore closer to a causal output description. Output score follows the latter idea but ties the intervention to contexts where the feature already fires, because the dual-end target asks what the active feature does in its triggering context.

blocks.en: The Output score went through three designs. The first design used the top 10 positive-delta tokens and rewarded the fraction covered by the proposed output hypothesis. This measured recall but was easy to game: a broad hypothesis could cover every candidate token and receive a high score even when the token set was semantically diffuse. The second design widened the positive evidence to the top 30 tokens and added negative-delta tokens. A selected negative token contributes its negative change, so over-broad hypotheses penalize themselves. The current design retains this precision pressure and calibrates steering per feature to account for variation in logit changes.
blocks.zh: 产出分数经历了三个设计. 第一个设计使用了前十名的正德尔塔符号,并奖励了拟议输出假说覆盖的分数. 这种有分量的召回,但很容易游戏:一个广义的假设可以涵盖每一个候选的符号,并且即使符号集是散乱的,也会得到很高的分数. 第二种设计将正面证据拓宽至前30个标志,并增加了负德尔塔标志. 一个特定的负符号会促进它的负变化,所以过于宽泛的假设会惩罚自己. 目前的设计保留了这种精度压力,并校准了每个特性的导线,以考虑到对数变化的变化。

blocks.en: VocabProj is useful but not stable enough to serve as the output ground truth. In shallow layers, the projected tokens often resemble the input-side activating tokens, so projection can restate what made the feature fire. In deeper layers, projection becomes closer to the actual steering effect because the feature direction lies nearer to the logit-relevant subspace. The middle layers are the most informative for our method, because neither input evidence nor projection alone reliably describes the causal output effect. The Output score therefore uses intervention deltas.
blocks.zh: 词汇 Proj是有用的,但不够稳定,无法作为输出的地面真相. 在浅层中,投影符往往与输入侧激活符类似,因此投影可以重现使特征起火的原因. 在更深层中,投影会更接近实际的转向效应,因为特征方向更靠近与登录相关的子空间. 中间层对我们的方法来说是信息最丰富的,因为无论是输入证据还是投影都无法可靠地描述因果输出效果. 因此,产出分数使用干预三角洲。

The complete 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 grid contains 27 operating points. Adaptive refinement raises the joint pass rate at all 27 points, by 6.4 to 72.0 percentage points.

blocks.en: Appendix N Output Score Filter Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录N 输出分数过滤分析

blocks.en: We evaluate the output-score filter of Arad et al. (2025) on Gemma-2-2B under the AxBench protocol and do not observe the gains they report on Gemma-2-9B under their own protocol. Model scale, judge model, instruction sample, and factor-selection rule all differ between the two setups, so the cross-study contrast cannot isolate a single cause; we list these differences to scope our conclusion.
blocks.zh: 根据Ax Bench协议,我们评价Arad等人(2025年)在Gemma-2-2B上的输出计分过滤器,不观察他们根据自己的协议报告Gemma-2-9B的得分. 模型尺度,判断模型,指令样本,和因子选择规则在两个设置之间都不同,因此交叉研究对比不能孤立一个单一的原因;我们列出这些差异来说明我们的结论的范围.

blocks.en: Arad et al. choose the steering factor per feature to maximize a normalized ratio of generation success, how often the feature’s top-20 logit-lens tokens appear in generated continuations, to perplexity measured with Gemma-2-9B, applying the rule to the five selection instructions at temperature 0.7 with factors up to 100. AxBench instead selects, on the same five instructions, the factor with the highest harmonic-mean LM-judge score over concept presence, instruction-following, and fluency; we follow this protocol with factors up to 10 and temperature-1.0 sampling without repetition penalties. In our setting the ratio rule selects factors yielding a mean holdout score of 0.105, against 0.140 for the AxBench rule on the same generations. Part of this gap is expected by construction, since the AxBench rule selects directly on the reported judge metric; we use it for the main comparison because it is the benchmark’s official protocol and, applied identically to both filters, keeps the filter comparison controlled, with the ratio-rule run serving only as a transfer check on 2B. The remainder is plausibly a scale effect: the ratio rule retains factors up to 100, while in our 2B runs the mean holdout score declines beyond a factor of 2.0 and generations at factors of 3 and above are dominated by token repetition, consistent with the factor-versus-instruct tradeoff of Wu et al. (2025, Figure 4); we hypothesize that this accounts for part of the gap between the two rules on 2B.
blocks.zh: 亚拉德等人. 选择每个特性的引导因子,以最大限度地实现生成成功率的常态化,在生成的续作中,该特性的前20个对数-连字符的出现频率,与Gemma-2-9B测量的迷惑性,在0.7温度时将规则应用到5个选择指令中,因数高达100。 相反,Ax Bench在同样的五个指令中,在概念存在、指令跟踪和流利度方面选择了口号-平均LM评分最高的因子;我们遵循这项协议的因子最高可达10,温度-1.0取样,没有重复处罚。 在我们设定比率规则时,选择了产生0.105的中间阻力分数的因素,而Ax Bench规则则在同代人中选择0.140。 由于Ax Bench规则直接选择了所报道的法官衡量标准;我们用它来进行主要比较,因为它是基准的官方协议,并且同样适用于两个过滤器,保持了过滤比较的控制,而比例规则运行只是作为2B的调试。 其余的可能是规模效应:比率规则保留了高达100的系数,而在我们的2B运行中,平均悬停分数下降超过2.0的系数,3及以上系数的代数则以象征性重复为主,这与Wu et al.(2025,图4)的因数与指令权衡一致;我们假设这占了2B的两个规则之间的部分差距.

blocks.en: AxBench samples ten steering instructions per concept from AlpacaEval and does not release them, and Arad et al. draw their own genre-aligned samples. Their unfiltered 9B replication scores above the published AxBench SAE numbers, a gap they attribute partly to this sampling and partly to judge instability. We run the official AxBench codebase, so both filters are evaluated on the same seeded AlpacaEval sample. The sampling therefore confounds cross-study comparisons of absolute scores but not our matched-coverage comparison.
blocks.zh: Ax Bench从AlpacaEval(英语:AlpacaEval)的每个概念样本中抽取了10个方向指令,而不释放它们,以及Arad等人. 绘制它们自己流派的样本。 他们的未过滤的9B复制分数高于公布的Ax Bench SAE数,这个差距部分归因于这个抽样,部分归因于判断不稳定性. 我们运行着官方的Ax Bench代码库,所以两个过滤器都在同一种种的阿尔帕卡-瓦尔样本上进行评估. 因此,样本混淆了绝对分数的交叉研究比较,而不是我们的对应覆盖比较。

blocks.en: Arad et al. score generations with Claude 3.7 Sonnet, whereas we follow AxBench and use gpt-4o-mini. Judges differ in their treatment of repetitive and partially steered text and can in principle reorder methods across studies, so the judge model is a further confound for cross-study comparison. Within our study, the same judge scores both filters on identical generations, controlling for this difference.
blocks.zh: 亚拉德等人. 与克劳德·3.7·索内共度世代, 而我们跟随Ax Bench,使用gpt-4o-mini。 法官对重复和部分指导文本的处理不同,原则上可以重新排列不同研究的方法,因此,法官模式是交叉研究比较的另一个困惑。 在我们的研究中,同一位法官对同代人进行筛选,控制这种差异。

blocks.en: The Output score is computed via a causal intervention that measures rank-weighted probability shifts for top tokens, and the gains of Arad et al. are reported on the 9B model. On layer 20 of Gemma-2-2B we find that high Output scores co-occur less reliably with generations that remain fluent and instruction-following, so the filter retains pairs that the AxBench judge scores low. We do not re-run the ratio rule on 9B, so our results do not speak to the effectiveness of the filter under the original 9B protocol; they show that the filter does not transfer to 2B under the AxBench protocol.
blocks.zh: 产出得分是通过一种因果干预措施计算的,即衡量最高值的排名加权概率变动,并报告Arad等人在9B模型上的所得。 在Gemma-2-2B的第20层,我们发现,高输出得分与一代人共同不可靠,而一代人仍然流利并遵循指令,因此过滤器保留了Ax Bench判断得分低的对子. 在9B上我们不重运行比例规则,因此我们的结果不会谈到原始9B协议下的过滤器的有效性;它们表明,根据Ax Bench协议,过滤器不会转移到2B.

blocks.en: Taken together, these differences indicate that absolute steering scores on Concept500 are sensitive to protocol details, and that our Output score null result on 2B is consistent with, rather than a disproof of, the positive 9B result of Arad et al. Our conclusions rely on comparing filters on identical generations under one protocol, controlling for these differences.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,这些差异表明,Concept500上的绝对方向分数对协议细节很敏感,我们2B上的输出分数无效结果与Arad et al的正9B结果一致,而不是不可否认. 我们的结论依赖于在一个协议下比较相同世代的过滤,控制这些差异。

blocks.en: Appendix O Reproducibility Details
blocks.zh: 附录O 可复制性 细节

blocks.en: Strict success uses fixed thresholds throughout the reported comparisons. The reported Input score is the harmonic mean of activation coverage and boundary rejection, but the input-side pass criterion remains stricter: both components must be at least 0.8. Output score requires a score of at least 0.5, and Functional score requires a score of at least 4. The candidate pool and round budget are fixed before evaluation. Candidate selection retains one complete, internally consistent interpretation triplet with its associated scores, with ties resolved by the earlier round. All three reported scores refer to this same triplet, and joint success requires it to pass all three criteria. Intervention keeps the top 30 positive and negative token changes, uses at most five steering prompts, and targets the maximally activating token by default. The maximum activation scale is 2.0, with a last-token scale of 1.0 when that scope is selected. The GemmaScope study comprises 200 features interpreted during skill accumulation and 50 held-out validation features, with 40 and 10 features, respectively, from each of layers 0, 6, 12, 18, and 24. We reuse the checkpoint-120 validation results in the final 250-feature analysis to avoid an additional evaluation run. The 100-feature subsets used for the component-matched baseline comparison and the short-context-probing comparison were sampled from this 250-feature pool. The Qwen-Scope transfer study fixes 20 features in each of layers 0, 7, 14, 21, and 27. DeepSeek-V4-Pro is the language-model backbone for explanation generation and judging, and tool calls use temperature 0. Within each comparison, the evaluated methods use the same feature list and the applicable shared evaluation settings; comparison-specific differences are described in their corresponding experimental protocols. Token counts include the complete agent context under each evaluated interface.
blocks.zh: 严格的成功在整个报告的比较中采用固定阈值。 报告的输入分数是激活覆盖和边界拒绝的谐音平均值,但输入边通过标准仍然更严格:两个组件必须至少是0.8. 输出分数需要至少0.5分,功能分数需要至少0. 4. 候选人人才库和周期预算在评价前确定。 候选人的甄选保留了一个完整的、内部一致的三重解释及其相关分数,其联系通过前一轮谈判解决。 所有三个报告的得分都提到这个三重奏,而联合成功要求它通过所有三个标准. 干预保持前30个正负符号变化,最多使用5个方向提示,并默认瞄准最大激活符号. 最大激活尺度为2.0,在选择该范围时,最后一个触发尺度为1.0。 GemmaScope研究包含在技能积累期间解释的200个特征和50个坚守的验证特征,分别有0,6,12,18和24层的40和10个特征. 我们重新使用120号检查站的验证结果 进行250度深度的最后分析 以避免额外评估 用于组件匹配基线比较和短文本测试比较的100个地块子集是从这个250个地块中取样的。 Quen-Scope转录研究在0,7,14,21和27层各固定了20个特征. DeepSeek-V4-Pro是用于解释生成和判断的语言模型主干,工具调用使用温度 0. 在每次比较中,被评价的方法都使用相同的特征清单和适用的共享评价设置;在相应的实验协议中描述了具体的比较差异。 Token计数包括每个评估界面下的完整代理上下文.

blocks.en: Appendix P Ethics Considerations
blocks.zh: 附录P 道德操守 考虑因素

blocks.en: The human evaluation was conducted by two authors with experience in SAE-based interpretability. They independently rated the same model-generated feature interpretations while blinded to the system scores and to each other’s labels. The evaluation involved no recruitment of external participants, no additional compensation, and no collection of personal, sensitive, or behavioral data. Language models are used to generate and judge feature explanations; their outputs may inherit model biases and should therefore be interpreted in conjunction with empirical evidence and human review.
blocks.zh: 人类评估由两位具有基于SAE的解释性经验的作者进行. 他们独立地对同样的模型生成的特性解释进行评级,同时对系统得分和彼此的标签视而不见。 评价涉及不招聘外部参与者,不提供额外补偿,也不收集个人、敏感或行为数据。 语言模型用于生成和判断特征解释;其产出可能继承模型偏见,因此应结合经验证据和人文审查来解释。
